# Weather Icons 2.0.10

Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/weather-icons/2.0.10/ (https://github.com/erikflowers/weather-icons)

- Font: SIL Open Font License 1.1
- CSS: MIT

Modified: the `@font-face` rule points at the local font files and drops the
`eot` and `svg` formats (not needed by Chrome or Firefox).
